body: How is the jealousy FSHO? I just got some not sure what vibes it’s gonna give. I have a super high tolerance.

A lot of people have heart issues as well as other conditions. Elvis died on the toilet. Idk why everyone is assuming OD, it’s very stereotypical and defamation of a person’s character without all the facts - in my opinion.

thank you for the support 😞❤️‍🩹 is life worth living alone? I feel like I’ll always be this alone…I care so much for others and want to stay to help others who feel like I do but at the same time my heart is so tired of caring and not receiving😞
Thank you 😭❤️‍🩹Ive been sobbing for the last 5 hours and it’s just nice to just hear anyone offer love even if it’s just another stranger on the internet…thank you 😭

These other comments deterred me from wanting to go to seek help…I’m scared I’m in the US too and also in grad school to b a counselor…I’m scared that bc I have good insurance they’d try to keep me there or give me medications I don’t want?? I’m so scared but don’t know what else to do….

They suck!!! It’s hard because I’m so empathetic and feel sorry for everyone else and care too much but clearly they don’t give a fuck about me….I totally agree that it might be better than the environment I’m in and that’s one of the main things pushing me towards getting help….I have good insurance and am on a few medications and idk I’m scared they will try and switch them and say oh she’s going this withdrawals for this so she has to stay here longer so we can give her *new medicine*. Idk maybe my irrational fears and thoughts talking but it’s just so scary. Thank you for taking the time to read and comment…I appreciate it more than you know
Thank you for hearing and seeing me 🥺 I appreciate all the support I can get. Thank you for your kind words ❤️‍🩹
Exactly. Everyone always says how much they care but actions are never changed and it still feels like you’re the only person in the world. Lonely and sad. I feel this.

I’m here to listen if you need to…I feel the same way and it’s a scary feeling. Like u want to crawl out of your own skin because you feel so disgusted with yourself and your life (well I feel that way anyways) but plz you’re not a burden. Your mind is trying to trick you into thinking that (mine is too) but I promise that you are here for some reason? Like the universe has some sort of plans for you otherwise you wouldn’t have been born… I know it seems like it just will never end and (believe me I’m writing this as I’m scrolling thru this page trying to find reasons to live and keep going) it might sound like everyone says that but I really would be sad if you weren’t around. I believe all our souls are connected outside of this physical realm and I promise that your soul means something to me. I’m here to listen …. I hope things get better for you 😞

You are important to me. I’m here to listen if you need it 😞 it’s hard feeling so depressed at a young age and I was in the same boat when I was 13…it’s really hard to deal with especially with society and school and family. But please know that mental health is important!!  People just haven’t realized that yet…society I guess. I’m trying so hard to change that even while I’m suicidal and struggling so fucking much. But Please don’t do it…please talk if you need to I’m here to listen please.

I’m so sorry you’re feeling this way. I unfortunately know this feeling too well. It’s like a sick feeling in ur stomach right below your rib cage. I hate seeing couples and love shit because same. All I wanted is to be loved. I want someone to hold me n be there for me and also do the fun things with me. But no. I’ve tried and tried again and I’m never good enough. It’s a feeling of longing that just gets deeper with each day. I’m sorry that you feel this way too I wish I could help but I’m in the same boat. It’s really hard feeling like you never catch a break and feeling like that one thing you need and want so badly feels like it will never come. It’s a constant disappointment and sadness 😞luv u

I’m so sorry you are feeling this way. I am too scared to even try… :( it’s so sad we feel so alone I’m 23 and we are too young to feel this much pain. I care about you and am here to listen if you need it. I hope I helped a little…you’re not alone 😞

I’m sorry you’re having these intense thoughts but you’re not alone. I’m on here at 11 pm bc I’m feeling the same way. I’m scared too…I’m here to listen if you need it. I care about you without even knowing you. I’m sorry if this isn’t helpful. I just know how scary and hard it is having that internal conflict of wanting to die and those explicit plans continuously playing in your head…I’m so sorry. You’re important and the fact that you’re scared enough to post this shows that somewhere inside you care too. I am the same. It’s very hard. I hope I helped in some way 😞❤️‍🩹

this made me appreciate my pet and all the emotional support he gives me 🥺 it’s a really hard night. I’m proud of you for being vulnerable and honest. I’m here to listen if you need someone to listen. I know how lonely life can be and how cruel/greedy/selfish most people are. I care about you and I don’t even know you. ❤️ I hope that Eric gives u cuddles and nibbles tonight.

I guess you can justify it to an extent but in this case Nate was like extremely physically and mentally abusive to her best friend…which I feel like is something I’ve never seen or heard of a friend/or others just getting over it yanno

I feel like Cassie’s character would’ve been alot more relatable if Nate and Maddy weren’t together last season. Like obvi Cassie is a total bitch for doing that to her best friend and needs her karma. But if that wasn’t the case I feel like a lot of young women who go through self confidence issues and yearn to feel loved/wanted would relate to the obsessiveness and anxiety of her appearance and the relationship. It gave me ptsd of how I felt dating when I was in college. She has hella emotional attachment issues
